description: Streamlined Specctra .dsn and .kicad_pcb autorouting entry point: submit an unrouted board with default compliance and retention settings to synthesize 100.0% trace completion with 0 native KiCad DRC violations. Use calligraphy_route_pcb for quick 1-step autorouting of .dsn or .kicad_pcb files with standard defaults; use calligraphy_compile_board instead when you need promo codes, 30-day ECO pass options, rush turnaround, or custom retention policies. Accepts sample_id, pcb_text, or upload_b64. Returns JSON with job_id, status, effective_sku, final_price_usd, proof_loupe_url, and payment instructions.

customer_email.description: Engineering contact email address for job receipt and license attribution. Example: 'agent@customer.io'.

filename.description: CAD filename with extension (.kicad_pcb or .dsn) used to select the parser. Example: 'design.dsn'.

pcb_text.description: Raw UTF-8 .kicad_pcb or Specctra .dsn CAD text to route with standard enclave defaults.

project_path.description: Local workstation path to a .kicad_pcb or .dsn file (local STDIO mode only) or sample_id.

sample_id.description: Built-in demo board identifier ('2l_rp2040', '2l_stickhub', or '4l_carrier') for quick zero-upload routing tests.

upload_b64.description: Base64-encoded binary payload of a .kicad_pcb, .dsn, or .zip archive.

name: calligraphy_route_pcb
title: Synthesize & Route Multi-Layer PCB
